title: Eighteen Out of Twenty

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: A day the Gulf ran: five Iranian tankers destroyed, twenty missiles at a Jordanian base with eighteen intercepted and nobody killed, crude near $100 with Hormuz shut - set against a cancer drug that doubles survival and airports reopening.

lines: Five tankers burning off a strait nobody can cross,
and the price of going anywhere goes up.
Twenty went out over Jordan in the dark;
eighteen came apart before they landed.
Eighteen out of twenty - that's the good news now,
a night that nearly happened, and then didn't.
Hold it like a lamp against the heavy going.
Count the things that didn't burn.
Somewhere a doctor got to say the word doubled -
one year turned to two, in the stubborn kind of cancer.
Ash clears, the runways open, August ships still load.
